messages:
Maya: Heads-up — we're planning a minor breaking change to the partner SDK response envelope (removing legacy `alt_text` field) that will impact marketplace images and some SI integrations next month. Need a compatibility runway + comms plan. Can we sketch rollout/telemetry checks? @Ron @Sam

Ron: Ack. I'll pull telemetry to enumerate affected partners and integrations. Quick question — do we have any partners hard-parsing alt_text into device firmware? ETA EOD for list.

Sam: FYI several HW partners do binary parsing on-device. If we drop the field without a shim they'll get parse errors. Suggest: header-based graceful fallback + SDK shim in v2.6.0 so old clients keep working.

Alina: +1 on fallback. For comms I recommend staggered windows: internal docs -> partner devs -> public marketplace banner. I'll draft a partner email and release-note blurb. Need timeline from eng. :spiral_calendar:

CI-Bot: Canary pipeline update: tests/compat/alt_text_check failing on 3 partner runners (runner-alpha, runner-gamma, runner-sis). Logs: `parse_error: unexpected_field alt_text`

Ron: Can we add a temporary response header, e.g. `X-RW-Compat: alt_text-allowed`, so older clients ignore removal? That buys ~4 weeks for partner upgrades.

Maya: Good idea. @Sam can SDK accept that header and map to legacy parsing? Also we need telemetry that counts requests containing `alt_text` by partner and model id.

Sam: SDK PR incoming — will check header and perform fallback mapping when present. I'll post the PR link once CI is green. For device-side, we'll share a minimal shim snippet:```json
{
  "response": { "text": "ok" },
  "meta": { "deprecated_fields": ["alt_text"] }
}
```

Alina: Proposed timeline: announce deprecation 2026-05-01, enforcement 2026-06-01. Plan: 2-week canary phase, then 1-month grace with header fallback, then enforcement. Does that work?

Ron: Works for me if header fallback lands by 2026-04-20. I'll schedule partner calls next week to confirm device firmware timelines. @Alina can you confirm partner outreach list?

Alina: Yup — I'll share the outreach spreadsheet and a draft email by EOD tomorrow. Also will add marketplace banner copy and rollback instructions.

Maya: I'll own the rollback/playbook and the staging test harness (partners-deprec board). Please drop links to PRs, test failures, and partner replies here. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
